events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: A timeless message
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, John Lennon gave us an album that still resonates today. 'Imagine' dropped on this date in 1975. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, known as Sting, the legendary musician and frontman of The Police, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Sting!
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to Sting! From The Police to a stellar solo career, he's given us so many unforgettable tracks. What's your top Sting song?

events.title: The first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago today, Apple launched the original iPod. It changed how we listened to music forever. Who remembers their first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Celebrating 007
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating the enduring legacy of 007, from the iconic gadgets to those unforgettable theme tunes. What's your favourite Bond film?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, legendary co-founder of The Beatles, would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Tribute to John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Celebrated British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy legend John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From silly walks to hotel chaos, he's a true British comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album,' on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The iconic White Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles unleashed their ambitious 'White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that showcased their diverse genius. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: A tribute to Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, the world lost a true rock icon. Remembering the unparalleled talent and stage presence of Freddie Mercury.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's influence
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and influenced countless artists. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the 46th anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon.

angles.name: A moment for Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. A moment to reflect on his incredible legacy.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Legendary musician and artist David Bowie would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Tribute to The Starman
angles.copy: Remembering David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator whose artistry continues to captivate. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. His music still reigns supreme.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist and producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Jimmy Page!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! His guitar work with Led Zeppelin defined an era. What's your favourite Page riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Iconic British singer-songwriter Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Rod!
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! From rock anthems to timeless ballads, his voice is unmistakable. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Suggs!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the inimitable frontman of Madness! Let's celebrate with some Nutty Boy classics.
